label: |capitalize
name: capitalize
detail: This is used to capitalize the first letter of all words in a variable. This is similar to the PHP ucwords() function.

label: |cat
name: cat
detail: This value is concatenated to the given variable.

label: |count_characters
name: count_characters
detail: This is used to count the number of characters in a variable.

label: |count_paragraphs
name: count_paragraphs
detail: This is used to count the number of paragraphs in a variable.

label: |count_sentences
name: count_sentences
detail: This is used to count the number of sentences in a variable. A sentence being delimited by a dot, question- or exclamation-mark (.?!).

label: |count_words
name: count_words
detail: This is used to count the number of words in a variable.

label: |date_format
name: date_format
detail: This formats a date and time into the given strftime() format.

label: |default
name: default
detail: This is used to set a default value for a variable. If the variable is unset or an empty string, the given default value is printed instead. Default takes the one argument.

label: |escape
name: escape
detail: escape is used to encode or escape a variable to html, url, single quotes, hex, hexentity, javascript and mail. By default its html.

label: |from_charset
name: from_charset
detail: from_charset is used to transcode a string from a given charset to the internal charset. This is the exact opposite of the to_charset modifier.

label: |indent
name: indent
detail: This indents a string on each line, default is 4.

label: |lower
name: lower
detail: This is used to lowercase a variable. This is equivalent to the PHP strtolower() function.

label: |nl2br
name: nl2br
detail:
All '\n' line breaks will be converted to html
tags in the given variable. This is equivalent to the PHP's nl2br() function.

label: |regex_replace
name: regex_replace
detail: A regular expression search and replace on a variable. Use the preg_replace() syntax from the PHP manual.

label: |replace
name: replace
detail: A simple search and replace on a variable. This is equivalent to the PHP's str_replace() function.

label: |spacify
name: spacify
detail: spacify is a way to insert a space between every character of a variable. You can optionally pass a different character or string to insert.

label: |string_format
name: string_format
detail: This is a way to format strings, such as decimal numbers and such. Use the syntax for sprintf() for the formatting.

label: |strip
name: stripmodifier
detail: This replaces all spaces, newlines and tabs with a single space, or with the supplied string.

label: |strip_tags
name: strip_tags
detail: This strips out markup tags, basically anything between < and >.

label: |to_charset
name: to_charset
detail: to_charset is used to transcode a string from the internal charset to a given charset. This is the exact opposite of the from_charset modifier.

label: |truncate
name: truncate
detail: This truncates a variable to a character length, the default is 80.

label: |unescape
name: unescape
detail: unescape is used to decode entity, html and htmlall. It counters the effects of the escape modifier for the given types.

label: |upper
name: upper
detail: This is used to uppercase a variable. This is equivalent to the PHP strtoupper() function.

label: |wordwrap
name: wordwrap
detail: Wraps a string to a column width, the default is 80.

label: append
name: append
detail: {append} is used for creating or appending template variable arrays during the execution of a template.

label: assign
name: assign
detail: {assign} is used for assigning template variables during the execution of a template.

label: block
name: block
detail: {block} is used to define a named area of template source for template inheritance.

label: break
name: break
detail: {break} aborts the iteration of the array.

label: capture
name: capture
detail: {capture} is used to collect the output of the template between the tags into a variable instead of displaying it. Any content between {capture name='foo'} and {/capture} is collected into the variable specified in the name attribute.

label: debug
name: debug
detail: {debug} dumps the debug console to the page.

label: extends
name: extends
detail: {extends} tags are used in child templates in template inheritance for extending parent templates.

label: foreach
name: foreach
detail: {foreach} is used for looping over arrays of data.

label: function
name: function
detail: {function} is used to create functions within a template and call them just like a plugin function. Instead of writing a plugin that generates presentational content, keeping it in the template is often a more manageable choice. It also simplifies data traversal, such as deeply nested menus.

label: include
name: include
detail: {include} tags are used for including other templates in the current template.

label: literal
name: literal
detail: {literal} tags allow a block of data to be taken literally. This is typically used around Javascript or stylesheet blocks where {curly braces} would interfere with the template delimiter syntax.

label: strip
name: strip
detail: Anything within {strip}{/strip} tags are stripped of the extra spaces or carriage returns at the beginnings and ends of the lines before they are displayed.
